STEP 1 - Scene: This is a small salad. It has mixed greens and a lettuce leaf cup filled with a lentil/grain and squash mixture. It is topped with a dollop of yogurt or labneh and a slice of chioggia beet. There is also roasted beet.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A square white plate. The frame is roughly 23 cm across, so I treat it as roughly equivalent to a 24 cm plate. Area = 3.14 × 12² ≈ 452 cm² (a square plate has a bit more, so I use ~480 cm²).

STEP 3 - Items:
- mixed greens (arugula, spinach)
- lettuce leaf
- lentil/grain mixture
- roasted squash cubes
- roasted beet
- yogurt dollop
- raw beet slice
- light dressing

STEP 4 - Area (food covers ~30% of the plate):

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Greens and lettuce | 18% | 86 cm² |
| Lentil/grain mix | 6% | 29 cm² |
| Squash | 2% | 10 cm² |
| Roasted beet | 2% | 10 cm² |
| Yogurt | 1.5% | 7 cm² |
| Beet slice | 0.5% | 2 cm² |

STEP 5–7 - Volume, grams and energy:

| Item | Volume | Density | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Greens | 86 cm² × 3 cm = 258 ml | 0.12 | 31 g | 20 | 6 |
| Lentil mix | 29 cm² × 1.5 cm = 44 ml | 0.8 | 35 g | 130 | 46 |
| Squash | 10 cm² × 1.5 cm = 15 ml | 0.6 | 9 g | 60 | 5 |
| Roasted beet | 10 cm² × 1.5 cm = 15 ml | 0.7 | 10 g | 50 | 5 |
| Yogurt | 7 cm² × 2 cm = 14 ml | 1.0 | 14 g | 120 | 17 |
| Beet slice | — | — | 3 g | 43 | 1 |
| Dressing | — | — | 4 g | 450 | 18 |

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 106 g and 98 kcal. That is plausible for a small appetizer salad.
